ideaReviews.finding: Klimmuur Centraal remains a current venue at Dijksgracht 2, 1019 BS. I amsterdam says it suits beginners and has intro lessons; entry €18.70 is only an indicative third-party listing last checked Apr 27 2026. Current equipment rental price was not verified; rope climbing needs suitable belay arrangement.

Beest Boulders Het Lab is current at Transformatorweg 32; branch and first-visit orientation verified. First-time adult entry €19.70; €5 registration, €4.50 shoes and optional €3 chalk bag are separate.
Beest Boulders Amsterdam is current at Willem de Zwijgerlaan 338B. Shared Beest tariff applies; weekly route resets and café/restaurant create social opportunities.

Current brand remains Beta Boulders Amsterdam at Stadionplein 18 (not Stadionplein elsewhere as prior note questioned). Adult single entry €13.50 off-peak/€14.90 peak, rental shoes €5; one-off novice intro €19.90 includes shoes and entry.

Monk Amsterdam is current in Noord at Aambeeldstraat 26. Adult day entry €14.50 (25+), rental shoes €5; no experience needed and first-time safety briefing is provided. Official page notes LOCO #1 on Nov 14, but no start time is shown.
Vondelgym Oost is current at Wibautstraat 131. €19.50 day pass covers own training or one group class.
Vondelgym West uses the same published network day pass price and class/self-training entitlement.
Vondelgym Zuid uses the same published network day pass price and class/self-training entitlement.
Het Gymlokaal West and Noord sell one €17.50 credit for one group class or gym visit, valid one month; classes include mobility, Pilates, yoga, barre and strength.
Eastbound Gym Amsterdam Oost lists a single lesson from €16.50, valid 365 days. For a novice, select bag training or confirm the class welcomes beginners.
Boogieland lists one group-class credit for €15. First-time visitors should choose bag training; technique classes require prior experience. Book a place.
Vos Gym is active and its webshop lists ongoing memberships, but no current public standalone one-visit price was verified in this pass.
Zuiderbad offers a single recreation-swim entry for €6.40; it is independent swimming rather than an instructed social session.
De Mirandabad remains active; official municipal update says 2026 swim impacts are limited, with major building works beginning early 2027. No single visit rate was captured in this pass.
Noorderparkbad lists single public swim entry €6.40 and single Aquasport class €9.60/45 minutes; no session date/time harvested.
Jaap Eden 2026–27 public outdoor skating season is Oct 10–Mar 21. Adult ticket €10.60; rental from €7/day; specific public block times must be checked.

findings: Public single-visit offer count: 12 (Beest Amsterdam, Het Lab, Beta, Monk, Klimmuur Centraal, Vondelgym Oost, Het Gymlokaal, Eastbound, Boogieland, Noorderparkbad, Zuiderbad, Jaap Eden). Direct tariff is distinguished from memberships and multi-class intro offers.

Best one-off beginner bouldering fits: Beta’s €19.90 Intro to Bouldering includes shoes and entry and is explicitly designed for first-time climbers; Beest gives a short safety introduction but its €19.70 day entry is self-directed; Monk gives a short orientation and has no-experience-needed entry.

Public schedule-specific date note: Monk’s official page says LOCO #1 is 14 Nov 2026 with new problems and a DJ; page does not show a start time, so no event row was added. Beta’s intro product calendar showed October 2026 and a time label, but a date-specific booking slot was not selected/verified.
No standalone ClassPass credit values were retrieved in this pass. Offers include no ClassPass price and make no credit conversion.
Swimming ticket prices are for access, not a class: Zuiderbad and Noorderparkbad public swim entries are €6.40; Noorderparkbad separately lists one 45-minute Aquasport class at €9.60.
Jaap Eden adult single ticket for 2026–27 is €10.60, with skate rental from €7/day. The season is open Oct 10, 2026 through Mar 21, 2027; day tickets follow public skating blocks.
gaps: No exact-start-time session was verified for Oct 19–Nov 30 in this pass; event rows remain empty.

Current primary rope-climbing fee and rental price at Klimmuur Centraal not found; €18.70 from a secondary directory is indicative only and should not be shown as a verified current price. Beest's shared official tariff is explicitly for bouldering.
Vos Gym single-visit price was not located; De Mirandabad rate was not collected.
Specific opening/class timetable availability for gyms, pools, climbing halls and Jaap Eden should be checked against the booking calendar before attending.
